Screen media with CCCreator metadata/quality probes and an optional
CCCreator/Bach vision provider.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --input TEXT:FILE REQUIRED 
                              Local media artifact path.
          --expected-kind TEXT:{auto,image,audio,video} [auto]  
                              Expected media kind: auto, image, audio, or video.
          --expected-format TEXT:{auto,png,jpeg,webp} [auto]  
                              Expected image file signature: auto, png, jpeg, or webp.
          --expected-orientation TEXT:{auto,landscape,portrait,square} [auto]  
                              Expected image/video orientation: auto, landscape, portrait, or
                              square.
          --suite TEXT [basic]  
                              Quality suite: basic; standard; deep; all; or CSV of
                              basic,black,freeze,silence,vision.
          --min-duration <duration> [1ms] 
                              Minimum media duration; explicit unit required.
          --max-duration <duration> [0ms] 
                              Maximum media duration; 0ms disables the upper bound.
          --min-width INT:NONNEGATIVE [1]  
                              Minimum width for image/video artifacts.
          --min-height INT:NONNEGATIVE [1]  
                              Minimum height for image/video artifacts.
          --max-width INT:NONNEGATIVE [0]  
                              Maximum width for image/video artifacts; 0 disables the upper
                              bound.
          --max-height INT:NONNEGATIVE [0]  
                              Maximum height for image/video artifacts; 0 disables the upper
                              bound.
          --reference TEXT:FILE 
                              Reference media for duration or dimension relation checks.
          --dimension-relation TEXT:{none,same,swapped} [none]  
                              Required dimensions relative to --reference: none, same, or
                              swapped.
          --duration-tolerance <duration> 
                              Maximum duration delta from --reference; explicit unit required.
                              Omit to disable.
          --black-min-duration <duration> [500ms] 
                              Minimum black-frame interval; explicit unit required.
          --black-pixel-threshold FLOAT:FLOAT in [0 - 1] [0.100000]  
                              CCCreator black-frame pixel threshold in [0,1].
          --freeze-min-duration <duration> [1s] 
                              Minimum frozen-frame interval; explicit unit required.
          --freeze-noise-db FLOAT [-60.000000]  
                              CCCreator frozen-frame noise tolerance in dB.
          --silence-min-duration <duration> [1s] 
                              Minimum silence interval; explicit unit required.
          --silence-noise-db FLOAT [-50.000000]  
                              CCCreator silence noise threshold in dB.
          --artifacts TEXT    Directory for report-only analysis logs, issue frames, and
                              provider evidence.
          --vision-analyzer TEXT 
                              CCCreator/Bach provider executable. It must match the
                              independently pinned LYRA_LINT_MEDIA_VISION_ANALYZER_SHA256;
                              defaults to LYRA_LINT_MEDIA_VISION_ANALYZER.
          --output TEXT       Write the screening report JSON.
          --fail-on TEXT:{error,never} [error]  
                              Exit policy: error or never.
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  $ lyra-cli lint command --suite registry,schema,docs,acceptance,workflow
  $ lyra-cli lint command --capability draft.video.add --acceptance-level L0
  $ lyra-cli lint command --run --acceptance-level L1
  $ lyra-cli lint media --input ./output.mp4 --expected-kind video
  $ lyra-cli lint algorithm-effect --algorithm draft.algo.ai-matting --baseline ./source.mp4 --candidate ./alpha.mp4 --artifacts ./algorithm-effect-artifacts --output ./algorithm-effect.json
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --ref local://my_project --require-segment
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --input /absolute/path/to/draft_info.json --require-segment
  $ lyra-cli lint draft --ref local://my_project --suite resource,resource-availability --local-resource-root ./draft

LEARN MORE
  `lint command` orchestrates acceptance; result lint commands provide report-only evidence.
